My visual data story

Which apps demand the most attention?

Bar chart showing average urgency levels by application. Messenger and Gmail show the highest urgency scores, while Entertainment apps like YouTube are rated significantly lower, suggesting social and academic pings are perceived as more critical.

The Hourly Pulse of Distraction

Line graph depicting notification frequency over a 24-hour period. There is a notable spike in notifications between 4 PM and 8 PM, indicating that digital interruptions peak during the late afternoon and evening hours.

The Cost of Interruption

Boxplot showing the distribution of minutes taken to return to a task. Social notifications show a wider spread and higher median recovery time compared to Life Admin notifications, showing that social media leads to longer periods of distraction.
